description: Measured on 2026-10-05. The corpus grew from 49 to 187 rows, with 130 subject-opener rows. No lexical rule beat the current one on unseen lines without losing narration recall. The best candidate, "strict" (world noun as subject plus world verb), kept recall at 1.000 but passed 0 extra WHY lines on 80 unseen rows. The current rule stays. Three tests now pin the subject-opener escape and the corpus size. Follow-up: T-022 covers the article-drop escape this work found.
title: Measure the subject-opener rule with corpus rows
